items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The opening section: h1, one sentence, two actions and an install command; compact for an inner page.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Plans side by side; the featured plan inverts, an enterprise plan can run as a wide row under them.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Questions as native details: keyboard, find-in-page and no JavaScript.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: Brand, links and actions, sticky; below 1024px they fold into a Menu panel. Inline or centred.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: Brand, link columns and a legal row; on the page or as an inverted band that closes it.

items.name: newsletter
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: A heading, an email field with its button attached and a note on how often you send.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact form
items.description: Name, email, topic and message on Field: labels, help and server errors wired to their controls, native validation.

items.name: logo-strip
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: One line on who uses it, then the logos at one height and one colour, in rows that wrap evenly.

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login form
items.description: Email and password with autocomplete hints, a show/hide toggle, keep me signed in, reset and sign-up links. The full auth flow is in Flightdeck.

items.name: breadcrumb-trail
items.title: Breadcrumb trail
items.description: A home icon and the levels on one line with chevrons; a long current page truncates instead of wrapping.

items.name: card-carousel
items.title: Card carousel
items.description: A row of image cards with a title, a line and a link that scrolls sideways; Previous and Next turn off at the ends.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: Your product against its alternatives, one column each with ticks; your column drawn out, the head held while the rows scroll, in a scroll box of its own.

items.name: header-bar
items.title: Header bar
items.description: Brand, a row of links and one primary button; under 672px of its own width the links fold into a Menu disclosure (Escape closes it).

items.name: lift-card
items.title: Lift cards
items.description: Two or three cards with icon, title and text; on hover and focus the card lifts and the arrow slides; the whole card is one link.

items.name: link-card
items.title: Link cards
items.description: Cards that each lead to a collection: icon, title, one line and an arrow that moves on hover; the whole card is one link.

items.name: plain-tiles
items.title: Plain tiles
items.description: A heading and two lines of text on a quiet surface, nothing else; three across, stacked on narrow widths.

items.name: split-card
items.title: Split card
items.description: A card with a photo on one side and a heading, a short text and a primary button on the other; the photo goes on top on a narrow card.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: A section header and three to six features in open columns: a bare icon, a title, a line and an optional link. No cards, no icon tiles.

items.name: call-to-action
items.title: Call to action
items.description: One heading, one line and one or two buttons, centred on an inverted panel: the closing ask before the footer.

items.name: stats-row
items.title: Stats row
items.description: A section header and three or four figures in a row, each a large value over its label; a description list with tabular numerals.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: One quote, large, with the person under it: a face, their name and their role. Initials stand in when there is no photo.

items.name: post-grid
items.title: Post grid
items.description: The latest blog posts as story cards, picture on top, under a section header with a link to every post; page links on an index. No card ends a row alone.

items.name: changelog-list
items.title: Changelog list
items.description: Releases newest first: the date and version beside the title, black and white tags and a line; a link to the full changelog and page links.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An action, or a link that looks like one: variants, sizes, an icon, a loading state.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short status or count next to text: default, secondary, outline, destructive.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field with a focus ring, a disabled state and an invalid state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field for a message or a note.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name of a field, tied to its control.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, help and the error, wired together with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: On or off for one option, with a label you can click and a disabled state.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that applies at once.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A panel with a header, content and a footer, for settings, summaries and plans.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message on the page: a title, a line and an icon, neutral or destructive.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or a shortcut of several keys.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A face, with initials when the photo is missing; in a row as a group.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Panels behind a row of tabs, arrow keys between them.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal that keeps focus inside, closes on Escape and returns focus to its trigger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu behind a button: items with icons and shortcuts, checkbox items and groups.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The native select, styled: groups, a placeholder and disabled options, no JavaScript.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short confirmations that appear and leave on their own, with an action to undo.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a few, with hints under each option; arrow keys choose.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with Previous and Next, the current page marked and gaps where pages are skipped.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where the page sits: the levels as links, separators, a collapsed middle and the current page.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder in the shape of the content while it loads.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns with a caption, a header and a footer, right-aligned numbers.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open one at a time or together, with the keyboard model and a height animation.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far along a task is, as a bar with its value read out.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value or a range on a track, with arrow keys and the value shown.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel next to its trigger for a short form or details; Escape and outside clicks close it.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: A command palette: type to filter, arrows and Enter, grouped commands and shortcuts.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: A search input in a role=search form, with a / shortcut and a clear button.

items.name: sidebar-nav
items.title: Sidebar navigation
items.description: A docs sidebar: groups of links, the current page marked, collapsible groups on native details.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A side sheet for filters, a cart or details: slides in from its edge, focus stays inside.

items.name: link-list
items.title: Link list
items.description: Links as rows with a line under the title and a chevron; the whole row is the target.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Nothing here yet, or no results: an icon, what is going on and what to do next.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A topic or an active filter: static, a link, or removable with focus moving to the next tag.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: Toggle chips, a sort select and a live result count; Clear turns every filter off.

items.name: filter-sheet
items.title: Filter sheet
items.description: The Filters button of a phone layout: the active count on the button, checkbox groups in a side sheet, Clear all and Show results.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Progress through a flow: done, current (aria-current=step) and to come; horizontal when there is room.

items.name: quantity
items.title: Quantity
items.description: Minus, a number field and plus as one control; the buttons turn off at the ends.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code with a filename bar and Copy, in a focusable scroll box that shades its edges.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A swipeable row with Previous and Next that turn off at the ends, keyboard included. No autoplay.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date field
items.description: The native date input in the field style, or a from–to range that keeps the end after the start.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls that is one Tab stop; arrows move. Toggle buttons, and a "Was this helpful?" variant.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value, an element's text or a whole page (its markdown), then says Copied for a moment.

items.name: read-aloud
items.title: Read aloud
items.description: Listen to an article: the browser's own speech reads it, with pause, resume and stop. Nothing leaves the page.

items.name: language-switcher
items.title: Language switcher
items.description: The page in other languages as links with lang and hreflang, behind one button; the current one is marked.

items.name: toc
items.title: On this page
items.description: A page's sections as links; the one you are reading is marked while you scroll.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Inline in text, standalone with an arrow, or external with an arrow out and a new-tab note for screen readers.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icons
items.description: Lucide, the icon set shadcn/ui draws with: a stroke, a size, a label when they stand alone.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Columns with their values on top and labels under them; the same data in a table for screen readers.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video player
items.description: A poster with one Play button; native controls and captions once it plays. Nothing plays by itself.

items.name: map-embed
items.title: Map
items.description: A location whose map loads from OpenStreetMap only when asked; the address works as a link without it.

items.name: story-card
items.title: Story card
items.description: Picture, kicker, the title as the one link, a line and the meta; standard, compact, wide and feature.

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section header
items.description: The head of a page section: a kicker in words, the heading, a line or two and an optional action.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: A single-choice toggle group drawn as one track, like a monthly/yearly switch.

items.name: result-list
items.title: Search results
items.description: An announced count, then ranked results with the address and the match marked in each snippet.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: One line at the top of the site on an inverted ground, a read-more link and a close button.

templates.name: free-home
templates.title: Home page
templates.description: A whole home page from nine free blocks, filled in for a car and passenger ferry: a sailing planner up top, the islands, books of ten crossings, an islander's word, the fleet in figures, questions and the sailing notes.

templates.name: free-sign-in
templates.title: Sign-in page
templates.description: A whole sign-in page from the login-form block, filled in for a sailing school: the card with other ways in beside it, the sailing office's number and today's sailing conditions.

templates.name: free-pricing
templates.title: Pricing page
templates.description: A whole pricing page from seven free blocks, filled in for a booking tool for hair and barber salons: three plans with a monthly and yearly switch, the salons that use it, an honest comparison, an owner's word and the questions people ask.

templates.name: free-contact
templates.title: Contact page
templates.description: A whole contact page from free blocks and components, filled in for a three-vet practice: the message form with every way to reach the vets, a map and the opening hours, the vets themselves and the questions reception hears most.

templates.name: free-blog
templates.title: Blog index
templates.description: A whole blog index from free blocks and components, filled in for a sourdough bakery's journal: the title and topic tags, a lead story, a grid of the latest posts, numbered pages and a weekly letter.
